entities.summary: Hamad, a notable figure in the history of Bahrain, associated with Kingdom of Bahrain and Arab Spring (2001–2010). Preceded by National Action Charter and Reforms and King Hamad's National Act. Their legacy influenced Mass protests at Pearl Roundabout demanding constitutional monarchy and Saudi-led Peninsula Shield forces enter Bahrain to quell protests.
